audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows contradicted their own whys: win[1] said Skill while whys[1] says 'he owns the level-2 trade outright', win[2] said Ornn while whys[2] ends 'genuinely even', and win[4] said Jayce while whys[4] describes your R-into-E-Q chain as something he cannot dash out of.
audit.why: Packet chart is Jayce / Jayce / Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Ornn / Ornn and matches every why row for row. 57.48% over 2575 games supports Ornn owning everything from 4-5 onward.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 4 flipped as one atomic group across both layers; ratings set to 3,3,5,6,7,6,6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shock Blast was tracked with no number, which hides the whole shape of the lane.
audit.why: Jayce's Q is 16/14/12/10/8/6s — a 16s gap at rank 1 that collapses to 6s at rank 6. Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1. The stance swap is 6s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[2].why, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Acceleration Gate is attributed to his W twice ('the W-gated acceleration', 'boosted through his W gate'). It is his E in Cannon stance; W in that stance is Hyper Charge, an attack-speed burst.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'Cannon Stance: Deploys an Acceleration Gate... If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.'

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was absent: the first attack after swapping into Mercury Cannon reduces your Armor and Magic Resist — against the champion whose passive grants additional bonus Armor and MR from all sources.
audit.why: Riot's R text: 'Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon... The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.' Only that direction shreds; the swap back to Hammer does not. The mirror flagged the same point. The swap is also an auto reset (missingInteractions).

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Jayce's Shock Blast is down.
edits.after: A second poke rotation plus Acceleration Gate, and you still have no answer — give him the level.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Jayce must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Bellows Breath lands and Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 — even now, so trade only in that gap and hold the wave.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — His main poke. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shock Blast: 16s at rank 1, 6s at rank 6 — sidestep it or hide behind a minion. - Thundering Blow: 20s, and it punts you out of your charge. - The swap into Mercury Cannon shreds your resists.

edits.before: His main poke. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1, 6s by rank 6 — a minion eats the orb for you.

edits.before: Track Jayce's Shock Blast: His main poke. Dodge it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: The swap into Mercury Cannon shreds resists — and Living Forge doubles what you lose.

edits.before: He gets a second poke rotation and the W-gated acceleration before you have any shield, so he owns the level-2 trade outright.
edits.after: He gets a second poke rotation and Acceleration Gate (his E, not his W) before you can answer, so he owns level 2.

edits.before: Acceleration-gate cannon Q poke you under tower while you have no shield or sustain
edits.after: Fire Shock Blast through his Acceleration Gate for extra range, speed and damage

notes: The 'W gate' error survives once more in the early block ('boosted through his W gate') — a phrase-level fix inside a 500-character paragraph that I left for a prose pass. Also unverified and untouched, as in this champion's other matchups: Bellows Breath is repeatedly credited with a shield and with being unstoppable (whys[2], spikes[1], early, mid), and Riot's W text carries neither; it is load-bearing here because the whole level-3 turnaround is justified by 'W's shield eating his cannon poke'.
